guidance.title: Acer TVs are Google TV underneath
guidance.body: Acer Android/Google TVs mostly run the standard Google TV platform (like most modern smart TVs). Almost everything worth disabling is the Google/MediaTek platform layer - the generic rules in this tool detect it automatically. Brand apps, if present, appear as com.acer.*.

guidance.title: Keep the TV stock
guidance.body: Never root, unlock the bootloader or flash a custom ROM just to debloat. `pm disable-user` already does everything root would, and unlocking the bootloader factory-resets the TV and can drop Widevine from L1 to L3 (Netflix falls back to SD).

guidance.title: Disable, don't uninstall
guidance.body: This tool uses `pm disable-user --user 0` by default: the app stops running and consuming RAM, but the APK stays in the system partition and every change is one `pm enable` away. Uninstall-for-user is available in expert mode for apps you are sure about.

guidance.title: Work in batches
guidance.body: Apply at most ~10 packages, then use the TV: check the Inputs/Source button, HDMI switching, Netflix, YouTube, sound, and the on-screen keyboard. The app enforces a batch size limit for you.

guidance.title: Launcher replacement
guidance.body: Google TV's home screen is made of ads. To replace it: install FLauncher or Projectivy Launcher from the Play Store, open it once, set it as default, and only then disable the stock launcher. Disabling the stock launcher first = black screen.

guidance.title: YouTube without ads
guidance.body: The stock YouTube TV app is full of ads. SmartTube (github.com/yuliskov/SmartTube) is an open-source Android TV YouTube client with no ads; sideload it with `adb install smarttube.apk`.

guidance.title: Un-disableable trackers
guidance.body: Some packages (e.g. Fire OS OTA/metrics, `com.amazon.client.metrics`) refuse to be disabled for the shell user. Block their domains at your router/DNS (Pi-hole, AdGuard Home) instead - that also survives factory resets.

guidance.title: Delete the advertising ID
guidance.body: On Google TV: Settings > Privacy > Ads > 'Delete advertising ID'. On Android TV: Settings > Device Preferences > About > Ads > Opt out of Ads Personalization. This is 30 seconds and cannot break anything.

guidance.title: Wi-Fi & remote first
guidance.body: If something stops working after a batch, re-enable the last batch first (journal has one-click undo), then narrow down one package at a time. You can always re-enable from this tool or by hand: `adb shell pm enable <package>`.
